ally.line.beacon.1: It's empty over there, safe to dig. Honestly.
ally.line.beacon.2: Signal's clean. I see no danger. But I'm watching.
ally.line.canopy.1: I planted a little shrub by the reactor. More Energy, you'll see.
ally.line.canopy.2: No swearing in front of the plants. They hear everything.
ally.line.current.1: Water's warm, burns are gone, poison's rinsed off. Back to the fight.
ally.line.current.2: I'm on dry land. Weird feeling.
ally.line.demon.1: Dig? I dig. Stand clear of the drill.
ally.line.demon.2: It's bright here. I like it. Don't tell anyone.
ally.line.doctor.1: Get up. You're not dead. I forbid it.
ally.line.doctor.2: The new arm took perfectly. Don't thank me. Just don't lose it.
ally.line.frostline.1: Enemies slowed. They're cold. I don't mind.
ally.line.frostline.2: Can I have tea now? Hot. Yes, I know.
ally.line.hive.1: The swarm found a nest. Over there. Bzzz.
ally.line.hive.2: The bees are on your side. Honey comes later.
ally.line.kiln.2: I'll carry you out. But only the ones who need it now.
ally.line.lineman.1: Got him! Hit him while I hold him!
ally.line.lineman.2: Harness checked. For real this time.
ally.line.mason.1: Reinforced your houses. With doors this time.
ally.line.n73.1: Your nerves are fine. I checked. Don't ask how.
ally.line.n73.2: The adaptant on the left is ours now. He doesn't know yet.
ally.line.patch.1: Woof! (Found Energy! Bringing it! Not eating it!)
ally.line.seraph.1: Don't stand in the fire. I can't heal you and your philosophy.
ally.line.seraph.2: The halo's on your side. Finally.
ally.line.standard.1: I'm Standard. Just Standard. But I try.
ally.line.standard.2: Another shift? I'm the backup. I'm always on standby.
ally.line.sweep.1: It's clean here. Safe to stand.
ally.line.sweep.2: Spare parts? Hand them over, I'll dispose of them properly.
results.control_win.1: Incident closed. The bill for the rescue has been sent to the victims.
results.control_win.2: Call closed. Gratitude has been expressed verbally. The bonus will be verbal too.
results.control_win.3: Infected neutralized. Its arm is now your hero's property. Your hero, in turn, is HeroOut property.
results.control_lose.1: Command Center lost. The cost has been deducted from the heroes' salaries.
results.control_lose.2: Shift ended early. Overtime is unpaid. So is undertime.
results.control_lose.3: Heroes have scattered across the city. Please return to the warehouse for the next shift.
tip.1: Tip: the numbers only count neighboring blocks. HeroOut counts the rest of the city.
tip.2: Tip: a resident attacks with whichever arm works best against the enemy.
tip.3: Tip: Seraph heals enemies. Take her out first. Feel free to tell her.
tip.4: Tip: Frostline freezes micro-reactors. Keep your Energy away from her care.
tip.5: Tip: Volt beats Cryogel, Cryogel beats Thermo, Thermo beats Toxin, Toxin beats Impact, Impact beats Volt.
tip.6: Tip: the threat grows every two minutes. HeroOut calls it "market growth."
tip.7: Tip: spare trophy parts get recycled into Energy. Nothing goes to waste. Especially at HeroOut.
tip.8: Fact: the most common call in HeroOut history is a cat in a tree. The cat has a personnel file.
tip.9: Fact: Crane No. 14 went insane at 9:14, exactly one minute before a HeroOut patrol drove by.
tip.10: Fact: there is no main villain among the heroes. They're all just trying very hard.
tip.11: Tip: gang up on heroes. The one who lands the final blow gets the arm; the one who dealt the most damage gets the leg.
hero.defeat.patch: Whimper. (Shouldn't have taken the Energy. Got it.)
hero.line.beacon.1: I see you! I see everyone! Attention all: I see everyone!
hero.line.beacon.2: Missing person found! You weren't missing? You will be.
hero.line.beacon.3: Attention! Person around the corner! Everyone over here!
hero.line.beacon.4: Found: you. Found: a nest. Found: everything. Telling everyone.
hero.line.canopy.1: You're lacking greenery. Let's fix that.
hero.line.canopy.2: Oh, so pale. You'll sprout in no time, sweetie.
hero.line.canopy.3: A weed is just a plant nobody watered yet.
hero.line.canopy.4: Sit still, I'll tie you to a stake. Tomatoes don't complain.
hero.line.current.2: Relax, I'll save you. First I'll drop you in the water.
hero.line.current.3: You're dry? That's a warning sign.
hero.line.current.4: Grab the ring! No ring. Grab me. I'm drowning too.
hero.line.demon.2: It's dangerous up top. It always was.
hero.line.demon.3: Don't be afraid. Nobody burns down there. It's just hot.
hero.line.demon.4: Four arms, to carry four of you at once.
hero.line.doctor.1: Open wide. Say "ah". Hold this arm. No, the other. No, someone else's.
hero.line.doctor.2: Patient, you have two arms. That's treatable.
hero.line.doctor.3: No anesthesia. But we do have gel.
hero.line.doctor.4: Don't worry, it doesn't hurt. Doesn't hurt me.
hero.line.frostline.1: No fire detected. Extinguishing just in case.
hero.line.frostline.2: Stay cool. I mean calm. I mean cool.
hero.line.frostline.3: Anything hot is a potential fire. You're hot.
hero.line.hive.2: Bzzz. Your route was not approved.
hero.line.hive.3: Monitoring shows you're alive. That's fixable. Bzzz.
hero.line.hive.4: Bees see everything. Bees sting everything. Bzzz.
hero.line.kiln.1: Hold on. I'll carry you out.
hero.line.kiln.3: Is it burning here? It will be. Hold on.
hero.line.kiln.4: Walls get in the way of rescue. No more walls.
hero.line.lineman.1: Safety lines! Safety lines for everyone!
hero.line.lineman.2: Hold still. I'll secure you. Forever.
hero.line.lineman.3: Heights are safe if you're tied to them.
hero.line.lineman.4: Second knot for safety. Third for style.
hero.line.mason.1: Don't worry. I'll reinforce you. From the inside.
hero.line.mason.2: A door is a weak point. Removing.
hero.line.mason.3: The building won't collapse if nobody goes in. Or out.
hero.line.mason.4: A support here. And here. And on you.
hero.line.n73.1: This body isn't mine. Neither is this one.
hero.line.n73.2: Seventy-two before me failed. I won't.
hero.line.n73.3: Your nerves. Can I borrow them? I'll give them back. Probably.
hero.line.n73.4: Control, I'm not an asset. I'm a question.
hero.line.patch.1: Woof. (Brought you. To whom? Doesn't matter.)
hero.line.patch.3: Grrr… (Good boy. Very good boy. Drop it.)
hero.line.patch.4: Woof-woof! (Owner? No. Owner? No. Fine, you.)
hero.line.seraph.2: Not injured yet? Not for long. I'll help.
hero.line.seraph.3: To the hospital! Everyone to the hospital! The hospital is up!
hero.line.seraph.4: Halo, heal everyone. Them too. Especially them.
hero.line.sweep.2: Ninety-nine percent of germs. And one percent of you.
hero.line.sweep.3: Freeze. Sanitizing. It'll be hot and clean.
hero.line.sweep.4: Washed your hands? Now the rest.
survivor.line.1: I spent three days in a basement. No signal, but the ads still worked.
survivor.line.2: We were evacuated four times. We never left.
survivor.line.3: I got rescued twice. The second time from the first.
survivor.line.4: The warehouse? Been there. There's a queue and free coffee. The coffee isn't free.
survivor.line.5: Is this my arm? Eh, it'll do.
survivor.line.6: Seen my cat? They got her down from a tree, and now she has a serial number.
survivor.line.7: I'm a HeroOut manager. Was. Can I just dig now?
cache.line.1: In the cache: Energy and a brochure, "How to Enjoy Being Rescued."
cache.line.2: In the cache: Energy and a complaint form. Already filled out and rejected.
cache.line.3: In the cache: Energy and an incident schedule for next month. Odd.
cache.line.4: In the cache: Energy and a receipt for a cat rescue. Six zeros.
cache.line.5: In the cache: Energy and a gift card for "One New Leg."
ad.gel: Lost an arm? Don't lose hope! Splice gel: regrows by Monday.
ad.dome: The Lumen Dome. A sky that never leaks.
ad.cat: Cat in a tree? That's no accident. That's a reason to call.
ad.leg_insurance: Insure one leg, get the second one free.
ad.lite: Rescue Lite plan: we save you weekdays, 9 to 6.
ad.energy: HeroOut Energy. Blue light in every home. And on every bill.
ad.crane: HeroOut Build cranes: they build by themselves. Sometimes even what you asked for.
ad.family: Your family is safe. Your family is in the warehouse. Same thing.
ad.kids: Kids' rescue helmets. No rescuing allowed. Dreaming is fine.
control.bark.run_start: Good morning, Lumen City! A reminder: all residents are HeroOut property. Please proceed to the warehouse.
control.bark.dig: Clearing logged. Thank you for working without insurance or pay.
control.bark.nest_opened: Unregistered adaptants detected. Please do not damage company property.
control.bark.trophy: Congratulations on your purchase! The receipt will be mailed to your home address.
control.bark.resident_born: Replacement printed and logged in the asset registry. The original is logged too. Twice.
control.bark.low_energy: Your Light plan is running out. Upgrade to Light+. Or to darkness.
control.bark.demon_waking: The employee assigned to this call is beginning the rescue. Rescue is mandatory.
control.bark.command_attack: The Command Center is under threat. Please remain calm. Calm is included in the price.
control.bark.win: Hero disabled. You will be billed for his repairs within three business days.
control.bark.lose: Command Center lost. Don't worry, its cost will be deducted from your limbs.
control.bark.idle: HERO | OUT. Always on shift. Even when nobody asked.
control.bark.part_recycled: Module recycled. Energy credited to the company account. Thank you for your contribution.
control.bark.threat_up: Threat level raised. Care level raised accordingly. So are the rates.
control.bark.heavy_nest: Heavy adaptant detected. A reminder: ceramic armor is HeroOut property.
control.bark.demon_warning: The subject of this call will soon start a shift of his own. We recommend preparing. Or at least getting insured.
control.bark.hero.kiln: Heavy operator Kiln is continuing the evacuation. Please do not resist being rescued.
control.bark.hero.lineman: Cable operator Lineman is providing safety lines. Please stay tied down.
control.bark.hero.frostline: Frostline is performing scheduled fire suppression. Power will be restored later.
control.bark.hero.seraph: Seraph is providing medical care. Complaints about the quality of care are not accepted.
control.bark.hero_defeated: Employee disabled. Their module is HeroOut property and must be returned.
control.bark.warehouse: The warehouse is open 24/7. The queue for the warehouse is also part of our care for you.
control.bark.hold_line: Your rescue is very important to us. Please stay on the line.
control.bark.plus: A reminder: without a HeroOut Plus subscription, rescues are first come, first served. While you last.
control.bark.rate: Rate your rescue from one to five stars. One star is still a rescue.
control.bark.resist: Resisting rescue violates the User Agreement, clause 14.
control.bark.dome: The Dome protects you from the outside world. The outside world is protected from you.
control.bark.dome_fee: The Dome protects against external threats. Internal threats are billed separately.
control.bark.care_zone: You are in a zone of enhanced care. Do not leave the care zone.
control.bark.limbs_warranty: Your arms and legs are under warranty. The warranty does not cover other people's arms and legs.
control.bark.lost_arm: Unclaimed arm found. Would the owner please proceed to the warehouse. With the rest of the body.
control.bark.build: Unapproved construction detected. We noticed. We notice everything.
control.bark.command_center: A Command Center not registered with HeroOut has been detected. We're already on our way. With love.
control.bark.cat: Cat removed from tree. Cat registered as a HeroOut asset. So is the tree.
control.bark.hero_on_shift: If you see a maddened hero, don't panic. He's on shift.
control.bark.pause: You have paused the city. HeroOut never pauses its care.
control.bark.survey: Are you satisfied with being alive? Answer "yes" or proceed to the warehouse.
control.bark.dig.2: Block cleared. Congratulations, it is now HeroOut property too.
control.bark.dig.3: You are digging on company land. Dig more carefully. That's our dirt.
control.bark.build_done.1: Building constructed without a license. A license will be issued posthumously.
control.bark.build_done.2: New structure added to the register. Rent has been charged retroactively.
control.bark.defender_trained.1: Hero completed training. No diploma will be issued: the school is not accredited.
control.bark.defender_trained.2: Amateur rescuer detected. A reminder: only HeroOut employees may rescue.
control.bark.nest_destroyed.1: Nest destroyed. Damage to company property will be deducted from your Energy. Just kidding. For now.
control.bark.nest_destroyed.2: Adaptants disabled. They were our best customers.
control.bark.resident_die.1: Asset written off. Condolences can be filed through your personal account.
control.bark.victory_extra: The city is yours again. Not on paper.
control.bark.heroes_count: A reminder: fourteen HeroOut heroes are currently on shift. Every one of them loves you.
control.bark.ally_start: A HeroOut employee has been detected working for the assets. This is called poaching. We call it theft.
control.bark.unlock: Employee has resigned of their own free will. Their free will is under review.
control.bark.hero_two_parts: Employee modules have been divided among assets. Splitting company property is not approved.
control.bark.speed_x2: Workflow acceleration detected. Overtime is not paid.
control.bark.rush_start: Crunch Mode. A reminder: crunch is not a malfunction. It's corporate culture.
control.bark.coop.1: A reminder: friendship between employees is not covered by your contract.
control.bark.coop.2: Energy transfer between employees logged. Fee: 0%. For now.
control.bark.coop.3: Teamwork boosts efficiency. The bonus is shared by everyone. Equally. Among all HeroOut employees.
control.bark.coop.4: An employee is requesting help. Help is a paid HeroOut service. Your help is a monopoly violation.
control.bark.raid.1: A group of adaptants is heading for your building. The building is insured by HeroOut. You are not.
control.bark.raid.2: An organized visit by citizens has been detected. Please give them a humane welcome. They're not quite human anymore.
control.bark.raid.3: Adaptants are heading for your block. A reminder: post-raid repairs are billed at standard rates.
control.bark.ruins.1: Building written off. The ruins remain HeroOut property. Renting the ruins is free until the end of the shift.
control.bark.ruins.2: Property lost. 50% off restoration. It's not generosity. It's marketing.
control.bark.limb_torn.1: Lost an arm? Don't lose hope. A new one grows back by Monday.
control.bark.limb_torn.2: Limb lost in the line of duty. Compensation is paid in limbs. Someone else's.
control.bark.knockout: Employee temporarily unavailable. Their shift continues.
control.bark.warehouse_escape.1: Attention: property is leaving the warehouse without authorization. Property, return to your shelf.
control.bark.warehouse_escape.2: Asset leak detected. Assets are running. Running is not listed in the inventory.
control.bark.warehouse_escape.3: Citizens, you are leaving the storage zone. Your loyalty has passed its expiry date.
control.bark.civilian_rescued: Citizen delivered to the Command Center. Transfer to another organization's balance sheet is being processed.
control.bark.civilian_lost: One unit of property lost. Written off as natural wastage.
survivor.line.8: It was cramped on the shelf, but my inventory number is gorgeous.
survivor.line.9: They fed us by inventory. I was item 4012. Item 4013 was dinner.
tip.12: Tip: citizens from warehouses run to the Center on their own. Nearby enemies hunt them, so cover them.
control.bark.rotation.1: Rotation complete. The limb has changed owners. The owner of all limbs has not: HeroOut.
control.bark.rotation.2: The "Lend a Hand" program reminds you: sharing is caring. Especially other people's.
control.bark.jammer: Jammer detected. Reminder: Splice gel runs without interruption. Interruptions constitute interference with property.
control.bark.roster: This shift, the {list} services work for you. The rest work for HeroOut. As usual.
control.bark.squad: Squad approved. All other services are on leave. Unpaid.
control.bark.mutation: Unauthorized limb modifications detected. Warranty void.
control.bark.forge: Recoloring branded limbs has not been approved by the branding department. A fine has been issued. To whom is being determined.
control.bark.shelter: Citizens housed outside the warehouse. Reminder: storing property off-warehouse is taxable.
